# eyes_calabash

**Tag**: testing

## 简介

Provides SDK for writing Applitools Calabash tests. DEPRECATED: Calabash is no longer actively maintained. Please use eyes_appium for mobile testing.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.applitools.com
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/eyes_calabash/6.6.9
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/eyes_calabash
